# Results walkthrough: index and provenance

*Generated by `eval/figs_results_walkthrough.py` at commit `4ab29fd`. This script only COMPOSES pages: it places existing, cross-checked images (thesis figures, summary charts, and the all-flights plots of `eval/figs_walkthrough_flights.py`, whose own checks are in `flights/index_flights.md`); nothing is re-plotted, recomputed or re-run here. All provenance is here; the pages carry none.*

**All-flights plots (ruling 2026-10-21):** 46/46 printed-number checks and 152/152 data-identity checks pass (`docs/thesis/summary/flights/index_flights.md`, sha256 `38c0f9fd36365f586b54da5622cc60febd7f724cc770598206208cc5761b18f4`). The world page appears once per experiment, after its last plot page.

**Contents-page note (NEW):** Each experiment starts with the simulated world it was flown in (screenshots), then where the drone really flew, then its plots showing every flight (one panel per estimator, never drawn on top of each other), each with what it shows, the metric, the pass rule and the result. Where an experiment has no per-flight plot, its summary chart is shown. A section page then opens the extension experiments (pre-registered) and the exploratory ablation.
